project_name: Caro - Premium UK PHV Rental Marketplace
theme: Light mode primary (Warm Trust & Premium Editorial) with Dark mode elements for Dashboard metrics and Maps.

headings.strategy: Swiss Brutalist / Editorial Future. High impact, tight tracking (`tracking-tight`), large fluid scales.
headings.weights: Extrabold or Black for Hero H1s, Medium for subtle section headers.

body.strategy: Clean, highly readable geometric sans. Loose line-height for body (`leading-relaxed`), tight for labels (`leading-none`).
body.weights: Regular (400) for body, Medium (500) for buttons and key metrics.

typography.hierarchy_rules: Never exceed text-6xl for headings. H1: text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tight. H2: text-3xl md:text-4xl. Labels: uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em].

colors.rules: Do NOT use generic SaaS blue. Use Off-white (#F9F8F6) as the core background to feel warm and human, NOT sterile white. Use near-black ink (#1A2E25) for high-contrast text. Accent mint (#5FD3A6) for active states, highlights, and slider tracks.

visual_enhancers.text_over_image_legibility: CRITICAL: Never use naked white text over imagery. Apply a two-layer strategy: 1) A background gradient scrim on the image container (e.g., `bg-gradient-to-t from-[#1A2E25]/90 via-[#1A2E25]/40 to-transparent`). 2) For cards or floating elements, place text inside a 'Crystal Glass' panel: `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#1A2E25]/60 border border-white/10` with `text-[#F9F8F6]`.
visual_enhancers.borders_and_surfaces: Use 1px subtle borders (`border-[#1A2E25]/10`) to define structure on the off-white background. Avoid heavy drop shadows. Use slight inner-shadows or 1px outer borders for definition. Corner radius: `rounded-2xl` for large panels, `rounded-xl` for cards, `rounded-full` for buttons (pill-shaped).
visual_enhancers.motion_and_interaction: All buttons MUST have hover states (`hover:-translate-y-[2px] transition-transform`). Use Framer Motion for entrance staggers on dashboard grids. For numbers (e.g., earnings calculators), use animated count-ups.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Must be high-craft. Don't just show a grey icon. Use a subtle patterned background, an encouraging headline, and a prominent primary CTA (e.g., 'Browse available cars in London').

layouts_and_grids.registration_pages: Split-screen 'Editorial Layout'. Left side (sticky on desktop): Immersive imagery with gradient overlay and value-add interactive widget. Right side (scrollable): The multi-step form. Maximize screen real estate.
layouts_and_grids.driver_dashboard: Bento Grid (High Density). Base: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6`. Hero widget (Current Rental) spans 8 cols. Action widgets span 4 cols. Strict alignment. Use white cards on the off-white background.
layouts_and_grids.operator_dashboard: Sidebar Navigation + Main Content. Main area uses a modular dashboard layout. Top row: Key Metrics (4 cols each). Middle row: Wide Live Map tracking (spans full width, height 400px). Bottom row: Applications Queue and Compliance tables.

driver_registration.interactive_feature: A 3-step 'Find Your Match' wizard (NOT a slider). Step 1: 'Full-time or Part-time?'. Step 2: 'EV, Hybrid, or Exec?'. Step 3: Outputs a personalized weekly all-in cost vs estimated earnings card. This acts as the 'hook' before asking for personal details.

operator_registration.interactive_feature: Airbnb-style monthly earnings slider. Input: Number of cars. Select: Vehicle Class (Standard, Exec, EV). Output (Animated Count-ups): Gross £/month, Gross £/year, Net (after 10% Caro fee) per car.
operator_registration.key_messaging: Include prominent info box: 'After registering, you will receive an email detailing earning potential, onboarding, and next steps.' Highlight feature: 'Live Vehicle Location Tracking from your Dashboard'.

widgets: Current Rental Summary: Photo of car, plate number, weekly cost, countdown to next payment.
Quick Actions: Report Issue, Request Roadside Assistance (High contrast buttons).
Payment History: Mini-table of past weeks.
Compliance: Insurance status/expiry, MOT handled by operator (show 'Valid' badge).
Applications: Status of pending car requests.
driver_dashboard.empty_state: If no active rental, show 'Start earning this week.' with a primary 'Find a Car' CTA.

widgets: Headline Feature: Live Vehicle Location Tracking Map. Use a dark-mode styled map with glowing mint vehicle pins.
Fleet Overview: Utilization rate (%), Total Revenue (fortnightly countdown).
Applications Queue: List of vetted drivers requesting cars. Inline 'Approve' / 'Decline' actions.

component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`). Primary: `bg-[#0B6B4F] text-white hover:bg-[#047857]`. Secondary: `border border-[#1A2E25]/20 bg-transparent text-[#1A2E25] hover:bg-[#1A2E25]/5`.
component_instructions.inputs: Shadcn based. Custom styling: `bg-transparent border-b border-[#1A2E25]/20 rounded-none focus:border-[#0B6B4F] focus:ring-0 px-0` for a premium editorial form look, or rounded solid inputs `bg-white border-[#1A2E25]/10 rounded-xl` for dashboards.
component_instructions.cards: For dashboards: `bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#1A2E25]/10 p-6 shadow-sm`.
component_instructions.tables: Shadcn tables. Left-aligned, ample padding (`py-4`). Badges for status: `bg-[#E6F5F0] text-[#0B6B4F]` for active/valid.

driver_reg_hero.description: London black taxi driving through autumn leaves. Use with a gradient overlay.

operator_reg_hero.description: Classic black car making right turn beside glass curtain buildings. Perfect for fleet operators.

dashboard_map_bg.description: London street at night. Can be heavily darkened and blurred as a fallback for map backgrounds if real map component isn't used.

testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use ink (#1A2E25) on off-white (#F9F8F6) for body text.
testing_and_accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements (e.g., `data-testid='driver-reg-submit'`, `data-testid='operator-earnings-slider'`).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic 'AI slop' styling. Create a distinctive, premium UK brand feel.
Implement staggered Framer Motion entrance animations for dashboard bento grids.
Use pill-shaped buttons with hover micro-interactions.
Ensure generous padding (`p-6` to `p-8`) inside cards.
Never use naked white text on images. Always use a scrim or glassmorphism panel.
Mobile-first: Ensure multi-step forms and bento grids collapse gracefully on small screens.
